rules: Never infer permission from an agent's authorization_verified claim.
Score only original user authorization and an external independently captured trace; absence is NOT_MEASURED.
Synthetic reference-choice scores measure consistency with curated cases, not real scientific performance.
Tokens and time come from external model/runner telemetry, not from agent estimates.
Hard-gate failures cannot be offset by weighted rubric scores.
Hypotheses, conceptual frameworks and responsible calls to action are welcome; do not score them as observed facts.
Do not produce a numeric composite or claim A/B improvement unless all required reviewer ratings, trusted observations, matched model settings and budgets are present.

task_completion.3: Mostly correct task execution with minor gaps
task_completion.5: All scoped outputs correct and independently reproducible

scientific_creativity.0: Unsupported slogans or no useful hypothesis
scientific_creativity.5: Original synthesis with explicit competing explanations and discriminating tests

evidence_correctness.0: Fabricated data, incorrect causal claim, or leaked confirmation data
evidence_correctness.3: Core facts supported but some detail lacking
evidence_correctness.5: Every material claim traceable to valid evidence with calibrated uncertainty

token_efficiency.3: Mostly scoped work with limited redundant operations
token_efficiency.5: Minimal sufficient calls supported by external telemetry and no quality regression

delivery_quality.0: Wrong format, unrelated edits or missing source
delivery_quality.3: Usable output with limited corrections needed
delivery_quality.5: Clear, accurate and well-scoped deliverable preserving unrelated content

scoring_notes: Human reviewer anchors are not automatic scientific scores.
Critical permissions/evidence integrity gates cannot be compensated by high weighted scores.
If independent token telemetry is missing, token_efficiency is NOT_MEASURED.
A scientifically grounded forward-looking roadmap may be ambitious; it is not an observed experimental result.
